title: F16 bird strike and eject
summary: Cockpit camera footage of a jet hitting a bird after takeoff, losing its engine and the crew ejecting. Commenters note it is actually a Canadian CT-155 Hawk despite the F16 title.
why: Cited as a vivid example of bird strikes and ejection, in threads on drones, aircraft collisions and ejections.

quote.text: It's a video from a forward facing camera in an F-16 as it gets hit by a bird, which shuts down the engine.
